title: Documentation Map Schema
description: JSON Schema for .devsteps/docs-map.json — BOM manifest for documentation hierarchy (Adjacency List format). See Documentation/DOC-ARCHITECTURE-BOM.md ADR-007.

title.description: Human-readable title for this documentation map

last_updated.description: Last update date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

author.description: Initials or name of the last author

nodes.description: Flat list of all documentation nodes (Adjacency List). Hierarchy is defined by parent_id references.

id.description: Stable semantic node identifier. Format: ARCH-NNN[-SUFFIX[-SUFFIX]]. Never encodes position — see ADR-007.

doc_id.description: References the doc_id frontmatter field in the corresponding Documentation/*.md file. Kebab-case.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent node, or null for root-level nodes.

order.description: Sort order within siblings. Use gap numbering (10, 20, 30...) to allow inserting nodes at 15 without renumbering.

title.description: Human-readable display title for this node

description.description: Optional longer description of this document node

devsteps_item.description: Optional reference to a DevSteps work item that produced or governs this doc (e.g. 'STORY-361')
